items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I had just hired a drummer to come in with us to play, and he had been working with Lionel Hampton, he told me

ctx.x: And this guy liked our -- liked our group, and he wrote a couple of things, and had a few tunes he wanted me to do, and we recorded them. In fact, he and somebody at one of the stations there got together and brought the group over, and I had -- oh, did I have my troubles! I had just hired a drummer to come in with us to play, and he had been working with Lionel Hampton, he told me, and I didn't know but what he -- what a drummer! Oh, he was terrific.

And he said well what made him -- he kept telling me a story, well, I left my drums over here. I'll pick them up tomorrow, and so forth, and so I said well okay, you know.
